debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to stderr (only for troubleshooting)

spool_dir.description: Root directory for printer spool files (queues, job logs, status)

lpd_user.description: System user account under which the lpd daemon runs for security isolation

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of print jobs that may be queued per printer simultaneously

max_job_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) for a single print job. Set to 0 for unlimited size

remote_printer_connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait when connecting to a remote printer before timing out

bind_addr.description: IP address for lpd to bind to. Use '*' for all interfaces, or a specific IPv4/IPv6 address

port.description: TCP port on which lpd listens for incoming LPR connections

ipv6.description: Enable support for IPv6 connections to the lpd service

extended.description: Enable LPRng extensions (e.g., job control, status queries) beyond strict LPR protocol

log_job.description: Log print job events (start, completion, errors) to the system syslog

log_level.description: Verbosity level for debug logging (0–7); higher values increase log detail

default_printer.description: Name of the default printer queue to use when no destination is specified

printers.description: List of printers configured on this system; each entry defines a print queue

access_rules.description: List of host/network access control rules for the LPR service
